scripts.predev: pnpm local:start && pnpm local:env && pnpm db:migrate:local:deploy && pnpm local:auth-seed
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env.local -- env NX_LOAD_DOT_ENV_FILES=false nx run api:serve
scripts.dev:bot: dotenv -e .env.local -- env NX_LOAD_DOT_ENV_FILES=false nx run bot:serve
scripts.dev:web: dotenv -e .env.local -- env NX_LOAD_DOT_ENV_FILES=false nx run web:dev
scripts.dev: dotenv -o -e .env.local -e .env.telegram.local -- env NX_LOAD_DOT_ENV_FILES=false nx run-many -t serve dev --parallel=3
scripts.local:setup: pnpm local:start && pnpm local:env && pnpm db:migrate:local:deploy && pnpm db:seed && pnpm local:auth-seed
scripts.local:reset: dotenv -e .env.local -- node scripts/run-local-command.mjs pnpm --filter @ticketbot/database exec prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env.local -- node scripts/run-local-command.mjs pnpm --filter @ticketbot/database exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:local:deploy: dotenv -e .env.local -- node scripts/run-local-command.mjs pnpm --filter @ticketbot/database exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env.local -- node scripts/run-local-command.mjs pnpm --filter @ticketbot/database exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env.local -- node scripts/run-local-command.mjs pnpm --filter @ticketbot/database exec prisma studio
scripts.db:dev-reset: dotenv -e .env.local -- node scripts/run-local-command.mjs pnpm --filter @ticketbot/database exec tsx prisma/dev-reset.ts
